parameters.instructions: Tools for the mydomain.com lab Active Directory. Every change is limited to _USERS > Lab_users; anything outside it is read-only or refused. Temporary passwords are returned only once: show them to the user and never store them. Ask the user to confirm before delete_user.

parameters.description: Overview of _USERS > Lab_users, the only part of Active Directory these tools can change: its sub-OUs, groups, and users with their enabled state. Call this first to see what exists.
Search the whole domain (read-only) for users whose username or display name contains the given text. Returns at most 25 matches.

parameters.description: Get details for one user: name, enabled, locked out, OU, description, created, last logon, password last set, and group memberships. Works for any user in the domain (read-only).

parameters.description: Create a new enabled user in Lab_users or one of its sub-OUs. Returns a random temporary password, shown only once, that must be changed at first logon. If no username is given it defaults to first initial + dot + last name, e.g. j.doe.
